check.contract: Query result contract Only the first row is read. Several rows, a missing declared column or a wrong type count as a failed check, and the node stays open. satisfied 1 / 0 or true / false. True completes the action. out_<name> Converted to the declared type and written to the process variable. missing Reason codes when not satisfied, comma-separated, e.g. CASE_NOT_APPROVED.
